author: unknown
content:
Bungie, if I'm soloing Archon's Forge, I shouldn't instantly fail if I die.
Seriously,

What is the point of splicer keys if I can't get back into the forge without the event failing?

I waste a key (because I have to at least try) and the stupid invisible wall on the window doesn't go away until the event was forfeited.

Make the window open faster, or increase the time limit to get back into the forge, or make it so using a splicer key is enough to continue.

Wasted half an hour and 2 offerings because of this shit.
